network_status.network: Valutazione preliminare del rischio alluvioni - eventi 2024
network_status.summary_it: La fonte distrettuale registra gli allagamenti del 21 ottobre 2024 presso il ponte sul Cottola e le fonti d'evento ne documentano il crollo, ma non è pubblicata una misura idrometrica tabulata della sezione. Nessuna portata viene ricavata dalle sole immagini.
network_status.summary_en: The district source records flooding on 21 October 2024 at the Cottola bridge and event sources document its collapse, but no tabulated hydrometric measurement at the section is published. No discharge is derived from imagery alone.

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
